name: Titan Streamer
description: Firmware P0 for the Titan wearable: streams raw PPG (HRM-raw) + accelerometer over Bluetooth (Nordic UART) as binary-packed, base64 frames. A phone (Gadgetbridge) or laptop (bridge.html) forwards the stream to the Titan ingestion API where all HRV/sleep DSP runs. Buffers to flash when disconnected and flushes on reconnect.
